recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic composition featuring a line of silhouetted soldiers standing against a bright, cloudy sky at sunset, framed by the dark interior of a hangar or transport bay, with a large black void in the lower half for centered serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the pitch-black foreground/silhouettes and the bright sky background
Horizontal alignment of figures along a central horizon line
Framing effect created by the dark structural beams at the top and sides
Warm lens flare accentuating the sunset point on the horizon
coreInvariants: Total black silhouettes for human figures
Cold blue sky tones contrasting with a single warm light source

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Soldiers occupy the middle horizontal third; text occupies the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright sun point on the horizon line acts as the primary focal point, drawing the eye to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright horizon, moves outward to the silhouettes, then drops down to the large display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space in the bottom 40% of the frame provides a clean canvas for typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale blue and white (sky and clouds)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the sky, extreme value contrast between light and dark areas.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-tone grays in the foreground

characterSpecificRedesigns: Reduced scale for secondary words to create a tiered hierarchy within the main title line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large classical serif for impact paired with a tiny, widely-spaced secondary line for a 'prestige' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic cinematic serif with Roman proportions
Modern alternative with similar sharp serifs and elegant feel
Provides the necessary stroke contrast and traditional authority

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle shot from inside a dark hangar looking out. In the opening, place 7 silhouetted soldiers in various tactical poses against a bright, cloudy sunset sky. The bottom 40% of the image must be solid, featureless black. Include a subtle red lens flare near the sun on the horizon.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center the main title in a large, light-gray Trajan-style serif font in all-caps with wide tracking. Below it, add a secondary subtitle in a much smaller, white, widely-spaced sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom area solid black?
Are the soldiers completely silhouetted without internal detail?
Is the text centered and legible?

mustRedesign: Any visible facial features on soldiers
Specific military unit patches or logos

avoid: Muddy grays in the black areas

postGenerationChecks: Check for silhouette clarity against the sky
Verify the 'all-caps' requirement for all text
Ensure no text overlaps the soldiers
Confirm the lens flare does not obscure the text
Check for symmetrical framing of the hangar opening
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouetted subject + bright horizon + dark framing + centered high-contrast serif typography.
